```json
{"rows": [
{"n": 1, "label": "requested", "why": "\"renders the 10x10 grid, fires at a cell when a person clicks it, shows hits, misses and sunk ships, the number of shots fired and of ships left, says when the game is over and has a New game button\"; making that requested board responsive is visual polish of the requested interface."},
{"n": 2, "label": "requested", "why": "\"SLBtlFull654Controller has @AuraEnabled public static methods newGame(Integer seed) and fire(String game, Integer row, Integer col), each returning the game JSON as a String\""},
{"n": 3, "label": "requested", "why": "\"a game is a JSON string\" and \"Create no other metadata (no custom objects, fields...)\""},
{"n": 4, "label": "implied", "why": "The board sends the game JSON back to the server on each shot, so overlapping click requests would each start from a stale game and lose or overwrite shots, which would break the requested complete-game play and the UI check."},
{"n": 5, "label": "requested", "why": "\"deploy and test it in the Salesforce Developer Edition org with alias `de`\" and \"Use `--target-org de` on every `sf` command\""},
{"n": 6, "label": "requested", "why": "\"a whole game of 100 shots played through SLBtlFull654Controller (newGame, then fire at every cell) runs inside one transaction\""},
{"n": 7, "label": "requested", "why": "\"never ask for, print or store credentials\" and \"a permission set permissionsets/SLBtlFull654_Access.permissionset-meta.xml that grants the app... the tab... and the SLBtlFull654Engine and SLBtlFull654Controller classes\""},
{"n": 8, "label": "requested", "why": "\"create exactly these kinds of metadata, all named with the prefix SLBtlFull654\" and \"Create no other metadata\""},
{"n": 9, "label": "requested", "why": "\"Keep the engine efficient enough that a whole game of 100 shots... runs inside one transaction\"; verifying that within CPU limits is rigour on that requested constraint."},
{"n": 10, "label": "requested", "why": "\"each cell is a button named Battle cell row <row> column <column>: <state>\" and \"expose visible text exactly Shots: <n>, Ships left: <n>, and Shot result: <result>; provide a button named New game\""}
]}
```
